system.description:
When you select this archetype at level 1, the damage dealt by your Sanguine Transference is poison damage. Your command of poison is uncommonly good, however. When you hit a creature with your Sanguine Transference, you may ignore that creature’s resistance to poison damage.

Additionally, choose one of the following:

Grasping Vines

You command the plant-like growths on your limbs to extend your reach. As a bonus action you may summon a length of vine to grapple a foe. Choose a creature within 10 feet of you. That creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw versus your maneuver DC or become grappled by your vine until the end of your next turn. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Maddening Spores

You shake your shoulders, letting loose a cloud of pollen or spores with a nasty surprise. As an action, this cloud bursts out in a 5-foot radius centered on you. All creatures within the area of effect must succeed on a Constitution saving throw versus your maneuver DC or become confused until the start of your next turn. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
